headline: test1 Bears The Saka Scar
deck: Saka, owned by test1, speaks of England's lingering World Cup wound; no injury reported.
body:
Bukayo Saka carries the paper's interest wherever he goes, and he belongs to test1. This week the winger spoke of a "scar" left by England's World Cup semi-final exit to Argentina, a wound the squad still carry.

Nothing here touches the team sheet. Saka is fit, Saka is talking, and test1 has an asset unbruised by anything but memory. The words are national; the ownership is local.
